result.brief: 提出 LeanWAM：用冻结视频生成器提取紧凑未来潜表征（32 个预测 token 加世界 token），两阶段蒸馏进轻量策略，实现高效动作预测。
result.reason: Probes which future representations a policy needs, compresses them into 32 predictive tokens from a frozen video generator, and distills latent world tokens into a policy — representation-level contribution.
